name: Two Paths
look: A cartoon of a boy in a blue shirt and shorts, seen from behind, standing where a dirt road splits in two at a blank wooden signpost. The left path leads to a sunny white castle under blue sky, the right to a dark castle under storm clouds and lightning.
use: A choice between a good option and a bad one. The sunny path gets the sensible or wholesome choice, the stormy path gets the tempting or terrible one, and the boy is whoever has to decide, often picking the dark path.
slots: the good choice (sunny castle path, left)
the bad choice (dark castle path, right)
examples: Start a new series at midnight
describe: boy standing at a fork in the road with two castles
kid choosing between a bright castle and a dark spooky castle
crossroads with a sunny path and a stormy path
cartoon of two roads, one good and one evil
signpost pointing to a happy castle and a haunted castle
